description: This file defines the SignatureV4 class implementing AWS Signature Version 4 signing process, including methods for signing requests, presigning URLs, and handling AWS-specific headers and request transformations.

classes.name: SignatureV4
classes.description: Implements AWS Signature Version 4 signing, including request signing, URL presigning, and handling AWS-specific headers and request transformations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the SignatureV4 object with service, region, and options such as unsigned-body and use_v4a.

methods.name: signRequest
methods.description: Signs an HTTP request with AWS Signature Version 4, adding necessary headers.

methods.name: presign
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL for an AWS request with expiration.

methods.name: convertPostToGet
methods.description: Converts a POST request to a GET request by moving POST data into the query string.

methods.name: getPayload
methods.description: Calculates the payload hash or returns UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD based on options.

methods.name: getPresignedPayload
methods.description: Returns the payload used for presigning.

methods.name: createCanonicalizedPath
methods.description: Creates a canonicalized path with double URL encoding.

methods.name: createStringToSign
methods.description: Creates the string to sign for AWS Signature V4.

methods.name: createPresignedRequest
methods.description: Prepares a request for presigning by handling security tokens.

methods.name: createContext
methods.description: Creates the canonical request and signed headers string.

methods.name: getCanonicalizedQuery
methods.description: Builds a canonical query string from query parameters.

methods.name: convertToTimestamp
methods.description: Converts a date value to a Unix timestamp.

methods.name: convertExpires
methods.description: Calculates expiration duration for presigned URLs, ensuring it is less than a week.

methods.name: moveHeadersToQuery
methods.description: Moves certain headers to query parameters for signing.

methods.name: parseRequest
methods.description: Parses a PSR-7 request into components for signing.

methods.name: buildRequest
methods.description: Builds a PSR-7 request from parsed components.

methods.name: verifyCRTLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the AWS CRT extension is loaded.

methods.name: createCRTStaticCredentialsProvider
methods.description: Creates a static credentials provider for AWS CRT.

methods.name: removeIllegalV4aHeaders
methods.description: Removes headers that are illegal for V4a signing.

methods.name: CRTRequestFromGuzzleRequest
methods.description: Converts a Guzzle request to an AWS CRT Request object.

methods.name: signWithV4a
methods.description: Signs a request using AWS CRT for V4a signature.

methods.name: presignWithV4a
methods.description: Generates a presigned URL using AWS CRT for V4a signature.
